visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short, dark hair wearing a black T-shirt and a silver smartwatch is seated indoors. She looks curiously at a large, brown cardboard package on a table. The room is brightly lit with white walls and a bookshelf visible in the background. A small white text overlay '神秘包裹' appears briefly on a black screen before the scene starts. (2) The camera shifts to a handheld perspective as the woman uses a green box cutter to carefully slice through the packing tape on the box. Her facial expression is focused. On-screen text overlays in yellow and white bubble styles appear as she interacts with someone off-camera who remains invisible. (3) She pulls the lid open and her eyes widen in surprise, her mouth forming an 'O' shape. Yellow sparkle graphics appear around the box. She reaches inside and begins to lift out a flat, rectangular object wrapped in clear plastic. (4) She reveals a custom painting on a canvas. The painting depicts two small dogs—a white Maltese and a tan Yorkshire Terrier. Text on the painting reads 'Mommy We Love U' and the names of the dogs. She smiles broadly, looking delighted and holding the painting up for the camera. (5) The scene concludes with her examining the painting's details, pointing at the dogs' expressions. A picture-in-picture comparison shows a real photo of the dogs in the top right corner for reference. The lighting remains bright and natural throughout the sequence.
